prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a hit while turning left. The patient had 44 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1489; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while the vehicle was turning left, when the patient's vehicle was struck on the driver side. Presenting complaints included headache, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating, consistent with a concussion. The mechanism and force of the impact are considered well matched to the reported injury. Over the course of 44 visits, care followed a typical progression, including symptom monitoring, vestibular and cognitive therapy, and graduated return-to-activity guidance. Visits became less frequent as symptoms improved and the patient was discharged to self-directed home exercises. Several examination findings, including balance and oculomotor measures, support the diagnosis, while other neurological and imaging assessments returned within normal limits. No prior injury to the head or neck has been identified in the available history. Two similar claim charges submitted on the same date are under separate review and are not reflected in this clinical assessment.
